adoption.rationale: The pinned slash-command review policy says to exclude any changed file matching secrets, and the pre-commit wrapper runs claude_review.py before lint. The exact helper filters paths before reading staged contents and constructing the Claude prompt, but its secrets\.json branch does not reject secrets.py. This adopts only the path-selection guarantee; it does not establish that any real file contained a secret or that a Claude service received data.

contract.declared_domain: ASCII repository-relative paths using slash separators, with one of the reviewable suffixes .py, .yml, .yaml, or .sql, containing the literal lower-case substring secrets. The formal counterexample is the concrete path secrets.py; the product gate stages synthetic paths and inspects whether get_changed_files returns them and read_file_contents includes their sentinel bytes. No Claude process or external service is invoked.
contract.guarantee: Before staged contents are read into the pre-commit Claude review prompt, get_changed_files excludes every staged reviewable path containing the literal lower-case substring secrets.
contract.input_source: Repository-relative paths and file contents staged in the local Git index before the pre-commit review hook.

domain: Counterexample domain: the concrete staged path secrets.py, a reviewable ASCII Git path containing the literal lower-case substring secrets.
